read_multiple_files.desc: Read multiple files in a single call — more efficient than calling read_file repeatedly. Each file's content is returned with a compact path/size header. Failed reads (not found, permission denied) are reported inline without aborting the rest of the batch.

params.paths: Array of file paths to read.
params.max_bytes_per_file: Max bytes per file. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Raise only when you truly need more context.

write_multiple_files.desc: Write content to multiple files in a single call — more efficient than calling write_file repeatedly. Creates or overwrites each file. show_diff defaults to false here (unlike write_file) to avoid flooding the response when writing many files — set true if you need to review the diffs.

params.create_dirs: Create missing parent directories. Default: true.
params.show_diff: Include per-file unified diffs for overwritten files. Default: false.

find_replace_in_files.desc: Find and replace text across multiple files in one call. Returns changed files and per-file unified diffs, while summarizing unmodified files by default to protect AI context. Always run with dry_run=true first to preview which files match and how — then run again without dry_run to apply. Supports Go regex with $1/$2 back-references. Handles CRLF transparently: LF-only patterns match CRLF files and original line endings are preserved after editing.

params.path: Root file or directory to search.
params.old_str: Text (or regex pattern when use_regex=true) to find.
params.new_str: Replacement text. Use $1/$2 back-references when use_regex=true.
params.use_regex: Treat old_str as a Go regular expression. Default: false.
params.glob: Only process files matching this glob pattern (e.g. *.go). Default: all files.
params.dry_run: Preview matches without writing. Default: false. Run this first before applying.
params.show_diff: Include a unified diff for each changed file. Default: true.
params.show_hidden: Include hidden files and directories. Default: false.
params.exclude_patterns: Glob patterns matched against each entry's basename (not full path). Matching directories are pruned before processing. Use to skip node_modules, .git, vendor, dist, build, or generated files.
params.show_unmodified: List files that were scanned but had no match. Default: false, which reports only the count to avoid noisy output.

path_exists_batch.desc: Check whether multiple paths exist in a single call. Returns each path's existence, type (file/directory/symlink), and size. More efficient than calling path_exists repeatedly.

params.paths: Array of file/directory paths to check.
params.limit: Maximum paths to return. Default: 500. Set 0 for unlimited.

get_multiple_file_info.desc: Return metadata for multiple files/directories in a single call. Compact one-line entries are returned by default; set output_mode=details for expanded labeled fields. More efficient than calling get_file_info repeatedly.

params.paths: Array of file/directory paths to inspect.
params.limit: Maximum paths to return. Default: 100. Set 0 for unlimited.
params.count_lines: Count lines for text files. Default: true. Set false for faster/noiseless metadata scans.
params.output_mode: "compact" (default) returns one line per path. "details" returns expanded labeled metadata fields.
